title: Rasmiy imtihon: yozish qismi
goal_uz: Dars oxirida IELTS, TOEFL va Cambridge yozish topshiriqlarining turlarini va baholash mezonlarini bilasiz, besh daqiqada reja tuzasiz, yuqori ball beradigan tuzilmalarni ishlatasiz va tipik jarimalardan qochasiz.

scenes.title: Yozish imtihoniga tayyorgarlik
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda badiiy matnni tahlil qildik. Bugun rasmiy imtihonning yozish qismiga tayyorlanamiz: IELTS, TOEFL va Cambridge C1 Advanced. Ko‘p o‘quvchi grammatikani yaxshi biladi, lekin yozishda ball yo‘qotadi, chunki vaqtni noto‘g‘ri taqsimlaydi yoki topshiriqni to‘liq bajarmaydi. Dars oxirida siz topshiriq turlarini va mezonlarni bilasiz, besh daqiqada reja tuzasiz, kuchli tuzilmalarni ishlatasiz va odatiy jarimalardan qochasiz. Uyga vazifa — vaqt bilan bitta to‘liq topshiriq yozish.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we analysed literary texts. Today we prepare for the writing paper of the official exams: IELTS, TOEFL and Cambridge Advanced. Many strong learners lose marks not because of grammar, but because of poor time management or an incomplete answer. We will fix both.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytganingizdan xursandman. O‘tgan safar adabiy matnlarni tahlil qildik. Bugun IELTS, TOEFL va Cambridge Advanced yozish qismiga tayyorlanamiz. Ko‘p kuchli o‘quvchilar grammatikadan emas, vaqtni noto‘g‘ri taqsimlash yoki to‘liq bo‘lmagan javob tufayli ball yo‘qotadi. Ikkalasini ham tuzatamiz.

scenes.title: Topshiriq turlari
board: IELTS Task 1: describe a graph/chart (Academic) or write a letter (General) · 150+ words · 20 min
Cambridge C1: essay (compulsory) + one of letter/proposal/report/review

examples.t: Task one asks you to summarise the main features of a graph.
examples.uz: Birinchi topshiriq grafikning asosiy xususiyatlarini umumlashtirishni so‘raydi.

examples.t: In the essay, you must give your opinion and support it.
examples.uz: Insho­da fikringizni bildirib, uni asoslashingiz kerak.

examples.t: In Cambridge Advanced, Part Two lets you choose a letter, a proposal, a report or a review.
examples.uz: Cambridge Advanced ning ikkinchi qismida xat, taklif, hisobot yoki taqrizdan birini tanlaysiz.

scenes.say_native: Avval imtihon turlarini ajratamiz. IELTS Academic Task 1 da grafik, jadval yoki diagrammani tasvirlaysiz: kamida yuz ellik so‘z va taxminan yigirma daqiqa. General versiyada o‘rniga xat yozasiz. IELTS Task 2 — insho: kamida ikki yuz ellik so‘z va taxminan qirq daqiqa, u Task 1 dan ikki baravar ko‘p ball beradi. TOEFL da hozirgi yozish qismi birlashgan topshiriq va akademik muhokama topshirig‘idan iborat. Cambridge C1 Advanced da birinchi qismda insho majburiy, ikkinchi qismda xat, taklif, hisobot yoki taqrizdan birini tanlaysiz. Imtihon qoidalari yangilanishi mumkin, shuning uchun rasmiy sayt ma’lumotini tekshiring.
scenes.say: First, know the formats. IELTS Task One asks you to describe a graph, chart or diagram in at least one hundred and fifty words. General Training has a letter instead. Task Two is an essay of at least two hundred and fifty words, and it carries more weight. TOEFL has an integrated task and an academic discussion task. In Cambridge Advanced, the essay is compulsory, and Part Two lets you choose a letter, proposal, report or review.
scenes.say_uz: Avval formatlarni biling. IELTS Task 1 da grafik yoki diagrammani kamida yuz ellik so‘zda tasvirlaysiz, General versiyada xat bor. Task 2 — kamida ikki yuz ellik so‘zli insho va u og‘irroq baholanadi. TOEFL da birlashgan va akademik muhokama topshiriqlari bor. Cambridge Advanced da insho majburiy, ikkinchi qismda xat, taklif, hisobot yoki taqrizni tanlaysiz.

scenes.title: Baholash mezonlari
board: IELTS: Task Response · Coherence & Cohesion · Lexical Resource · Grammatical Range & Accuracy
Cambridge: Content · Communicative Achievement · Organisation · Language

examples.t: Task response means answering every part of the question.
examples.uz: Task response — savolning har bir qismiga javob berish.

examples.t: Cohesion is how smoothly your ideas link together.
examples.uz: Cohesion — fikrlaringiz bir-biriga qanchalik silliq bog‘lanishi.

examples.t: Lexical resource is the range and precision of your vocabulary.
examples.uz: Lexical resource — lug‘atingizning xilma-xilligi va aniqligi.

scenes.say_native: Mezonlarni bilmasdan yozish — qoidasiz o‘ynash. IELTS yozishda to‘rtta teng mezon bor: Task Response — savolga to‘liq javob; Coherence and Cohesion — izchillik va bog‘lanish; Lexical Resource — lug‘at xilma-xilligi va aniqligi; Grammatical Range and Accuracy — grammatikaning xilma-xilligi va to‘g‘riligi. Cambridge da mezonlar boshqacha nomlanadi: Content, Communicative Achievement, Organisation va Language. Tushunchalar o‘xshash: mazmun, uslub, tuzilma va til. Muhim xulosa: faqat xatosiz yozish yetarli emas; murakkab tuzilmalar, aniq so‘zlar va to‘liq javob ham kerak. Ya’ni oddiy lekin xatosiz insho yuqori ball olmaydi.
scenes.say: In IELTS Writing there are four equal criteria: Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, and Grammatical Range and Accuracy. Cambridge uses Content, Communicative Achievement, Organisation and Language. The ideas are similar: do the task, organise it clearly, use precise vocabulary and varied grammar. Simple but error-free writing will not reach the top band.
scenes.say_uz: IELTS yozishda to‘rtta teng mezon bor: topshiriqqa javob, izchillik va bog‘lanish, lug‘at va grammatika xilma-xilligi hamda aniqligi. Cambridge da mazmun, kommunikativ yutuq, tuzilma va til. G‘oyalar o‘xshash. Oddiy, lekin xatosiz yozuv eng yuqori ballga yetmaydi.

scenes.title: Xato: mezonlarni noto‘g‘ri tushunish

examples.t: The question has two parts, so my essay must address both.
examples.uz: Savol ikki qismdan iborat, shuning uchun inshoyim ikkalasiga ham javob berishi kerak.

examples.t: Examiners can recognise memorised paragraphs immediately.
examples.uz: Imtihonchilar yodlangan abzatslarni darhol taniydi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato — faqat grammatika muhim deb o‘ylash. Aslida to‘rt mezon teng og‘irlikka ega. Ikkinchi xato — savolning faqat bir qismiga javob berish. Agar savol „Discuss both views and give your opinion“ desa, uchta narsani qilishingiz kerak: ikkala fikrni muhokama qilish va o‘z fikringizni aytish. Uchinchi xato — yodlangan shablon matnlar. Imtihonchilar ularni darhol taniydi va mavzuga mos bo‘lmasa, ballni pasaytiradi. O‘zbek abituriyentlari ko‘pincha tayyor insho yod oladi, lekin bu yerda moslashuvchan tuzilma kerak, qolipli matn emas.
scenes.say: The first myth is that only grammar matters. All four criteria carry equal weight. The second is answering only half the question. If it says discuss both views and give your opinion, you must do all three things. The third is using memorised templates. Examiners recognise them immediately, and if they do not fit the topic, marks drop.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi xato — faqat grammatika muhim deb o‘ylash. To‘rt mezon teng. Ikkinchisi — savolning faqat yarmiga javob berish. Uchinchisi — yodlangan shablonlar: imtihonchilar ularni taniydi va mavzuga mos kelmasa, ball tushadi.

scenes.title: Mashq: savolni qismlarga ajrating
board: Some people think universities should teach practical skills only. Others disagree. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
How many parts must you answer?
scenes.say_native: Savolni o‘qing: „Ba’zilar universitetlar faqat amaliy ko‘nikmalarni o‘rgatishi kerak deb hisoblaydi, boshqalar rozi emas. Ikkala fikrni muhokama qiling va o‘z fikringizni bildiring.“ Savol necha qismdan iborat? Har birini ayting. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Read the question. Some people think universities should teach practical skills only. Others disagree. Discuss both views and give your opinion. How many parts must you answer, and what are they?
scenes.say_uz: Savolni o‘qing. Ba’zilar universitetlar faqat amaliy ko‘nikmalarni o‘rgatishi kerak deb hisoblaydi, boshqalar rozi emas. Ikkala fikrni muhokama qiling va o‘z fikringizni bildiring. Necha qismga javob berishingiz kerak va ular qaysilar?

scenes.title: Javob: uch qism

examples.t: I will discuss both views before explaining my own position.
examples.uz: O‘z pozitsiyamni tushuntirishdan oldin ikkala fikrni muhokama qilaman.

scenes.say_native: Uch qism bor. Birinchisi — universitetlar faqat amaliy ko‘nikma o‘rgatishi kerak degan fikr. Ikkinchisi — qarama-qarshi fikr: keng ta’lim ham zarur. Uchinchisi — sizning o‘z fikringiz va u aniq bo‘lishi shart. Ko‘p o‘quvchi uchinchi qismni unutadi yoki oxirigacha noaniq qoldiradi. Shuning uchun kirish qismidayoq pozitsiyani ayting: „I will discuss both views before explaining my own position“. „Position“ — nuqtai nazar. Bu jumla bilan imtihonchi sizning maqsadingizni darhol tushunadi. Sizning javobingizda uchta qism bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri tahlil qilgansiz.
scenes.say: There are three parts. First, the view that universities should teach only practical skills. Second, the opposing view that a broader education matters. Third, your own opinion, clearly stated. Many candidates forget the third part. State your position early: I will discuss both views before explaining my own position.
scenes.say_uz: Uch qism bor. Birinchi: universitetlar faqat amaliy ko‘nikmalarni o‘rgatsin degan fikr. Ikkinchi: keng ta’lim ham muhim degan qarama-qarshi fikr. Uchinchi: sizning aniq bildirilgan fikringiz. Ko‘pchilik uchinchi qismni unutadi, shuning uchun pozitsiyani erta ayting.

scenes.title: Besh daqiqalik reja

examples.t: Underline the key words in the question first.
examples.uz: Avval savoldagi kalit so‘zlarning tagiga chizing.

examples.t: Choose two strong ideas rather than five weak ones.
examples.uz: Beshta kuchsiz fikr o‘rniga ikkita kuchli fikrni tanlang.

examples.t: Write one example next to each idea in your plan.
examples.uz: Rejangizda har bir fikr yoniga bitta misol yozing.

scenes.say_native: Besh daqiqalik reja imtihondagi eng foydali odat. Birinchi daqiqa: savolni tahlil qiling va kalit so‘zlarning tagiga chizing. Keyingi ikki daqiqa: ikkita kuchli fikr va har biri uchun bitta misol toping; beshta kuchsiz fikr o‘rniga ikkita kuchlisi yaxshiroq. Keyingi daqiqa: abzatslar tartibini belgilang. Oxirgi daqiqa: kirishni yozing va o‘z pozitsiyangizni ayting. Reja ham tartibli yozishga imkon beradi, ham so‘z chegarasidan o‘tib ketmaslikka yordam beradi. O‘zbekcha „yozib ketaveraman, keyin tuzataman“ usuli imtihonda ishlamaydi, chunki qoralamani qayta yozishga vaqt qolmaydi.
scenes.say: A five-minute plan is the best habit you can build. Minute one: analyse the question and underline the key words. Minutes two and three: choose two strong ideas and one example for each. Minute four: decide the order of paragraphs. Minute five: write your introduction and state your position. Two strong ideas beat five weak ones.
scenes.say_uz: Besh daqiqalik reja eng foydali odat. Birinchi daqiqa: savolni tahlil qiling va kalit so‘zlarni belgilang. Ikkinchi va uchinchi daqiqa: ikkita kuchli fikr va ularga bittadan misol tanlang. To‘rtinchi: abzatslar tartibini belgilang. Beshinchi: kirishni yozing va pozitsiyani ayting.

scenes.title: Xato: rejasiz yozish

examples.t: I spent four minutes planning, so I wrote with confidence.
examples.uz: Men to‘rt daqiqa reja tuzdim, shuning uchun ishonch bilan yozdim.

examples.t: Leave the last three minutes for checking.
examples.uz: Oxirgi uch daqiqani tekshirishga qoldiring.

scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — o‘ylamasdan yozishni boshlash. Natijada fikrlar tartibsiz bo‘ladi va abzatslar o‘zaro bog‘lanmaydi. Ikkinchi xato — juda ko‘p fikr keltirish, lekin hech birini rivojlantirmaslik. Examiner yuzaki beshta fikrdan ko‘ra, chuqur ikkitasini afzal ko‘radi. Uchinchi xato — tekshirishga vaqt qoldirmaslik. Oxirgi uch daqiqani artikl, ko‘plik, fe’l zamoni va imlo xatolarini topishga ajrating. Masalan, o‘zbekcha so‘zlovchilar ko‘pincha artikllarni tashlab ketadi, shuning uchun „a“, „an“ va „the“ ni alohida tekshiring.
scenes.say: The most common error is starting to write straight away. Ideas come out in a muddle and paragraphs do not connect. Another is listing five ideas without developing any of them. Examiners prefer two well-developed ideas. And do not skip proofreading: leave the last three minutes for articles, plurals, verb tenses and spelling.
scenes.say_uz: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri yozishni boshlash. Fikrlar tartibsiz chiqadi va abzatslar bog‘lanmaydi. Yana bir xato — beshta fikrni rivojlantirmasdan sanash. Oxirgi uch daqiqani artikl, ko‘plik, zamon va imlo tekshiruviga qoldiring.

scenes.title: Mashq: bir daqiqada reja
board: Topic: Remote work should become the norm for office jobs. To what extent do you agree?
scenes.say_native: Mavzu: „Ofis ishlari uchun masofaviy ishlash me’yorga aylanishi kerak. Qanchalik rozisiz?“ Bir daqiqa ichida o‘z pozitsiyangizni, ikkita fikrni va ularning har biriga bitta misolni ayting. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: The topic is: remote work should become the norm for office jobs. To what extent do you agree? Give your position, two ideas, and one example for each, in about a minute.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: ofis ishlari uchun masofaviy ishlash me’yorga aylanishi kerak. Qanchalik rozisiz? Taxminan bir daqiqada pozitsiyangizni, ikkita fikrni va har biriga bitta misolni ayting.

scenes.title: Javob: reja namunasi
board: Idea 2: teamwork suffers → junior staff learn less

examples.t: I largely agree, although fully remote work has clear drawbacks.
examples.uz: Asosan roziman, biroq to‘liq masofaviy ishning aniq kamchiliklari bor.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy reja: pozitsiya — qisman roziman. Birinchi fikr: moslashuvchanlik yo‘lga ketadigan vaqtni qisqartiradi, misol — shaharlararo qatnashga ikki soat sarflaydigan xodimlar. Ikkinchi fikr: jamoaviy ish zaiflashadi, ayniqsa yangi xodimlar hamkasblardan kamroq o‘rganadi. Xulosa: gibrid model eng yaxshisi. „To what extent do you agree“ savolida „qisman roziman“ ham to‘g‘ri javob bo‘la oladi, faqat uni aniq asoslash kerak. „Largely“ — asosan, „drawbacks“ — kamchiliklar. Sizning rejangizda pozitsiya, ikki fikr va misollar bo‘lsa, topshiriq bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model plan. Position: I largely agree, although fully remote work has clear drawbacks. Idea one: flexibility cuts commuting time, for example for staff who spend two hours travelling. Idea two: teamwork suffers, and junior employees learn less from colleagues. Conclusion: a hybrid model works best. A partial agreement is acceptable if you support it clearly.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy reja. Pozitsiya: asosan roziman, biroq to‘liq masofaviy ishning aniq kamchiliklari bor. Birinchi fikr: moslashuvchanlik yo‘lga ketadigan vaqtni qisqartiradi. Ikkinchi fikr: jamoaviy ish zaiflashadi, yosh xodimlar kamroq o‘rganadi. Xulosa: gibrid model eng yaxshi. Qisman rozilik asoslansa, qabul qilinadi.

scenes.title: Yuqori ball uchun tuzilmalar
board: Body: topic sentence → explain → example → link
Conclusion: restate position, no new ideas

examples.t: It is often argued that remote work should replace the office; I partly agree.
examples.uz: Ko‘pincha masofaviy ish ofisni almashtirishi kerak deyiladi; men qisman roziman.

examples.t: One key advantage is flexibility. For instance, employees save hours of commuting.
examples.uz: Bitta asosiy afzallik — moslashuvchanlik. Masalan, xodimlar qatnovda soatlab vaqtni tejaydi.

examples.t: That said, the lack of face-to-face contact can slow down learning.
examples.uz: Shunday bo‘lsa-da, yuzma-yuz aloqa yo‘qligi o‘rganishni sekinlashtirishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Kuchli insho tuzilishi: kirishda savolni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qayta ifodalang va pozitsiyani ayting. Asosiy abzatsda quyidagi tartib ishlaydi: mavzu gapi, izoh, misol va keyingi abzatsga bog‘lash. Xulosada pozitsiyani takrorlang, yangi fikr qo‘shmang. Bog‘lovchi vositalar xilma-xil bo‘lsin: „whereas“ — holbuki, „consequently“ — natijada, „that said“ — shunday bo‘lsa-da. Bog‘lovchini ko‘p ishlatish emas, to‘g‘ri ishlatish muhim. „Firstly, secondly, finally“ ni haddan tashqari ishlatmang. Yaxshi insho o‘zbekcha „bir tomondan… ikkinchi tomondan…“ mantiqiga o‘xshaydi, lekin har abzats bitta aniq fikrga bag‘ishlanishi kerak.
scenes.say: A strong essay has a clear shape. In the introduction, paraphrase the question and state your position. Each body paragraph moves from a topic sentence to an explanation, an example and a link. The conclusion restates your position and adds no new ideas. Use varied linking words: whereas, consequently, that said. Quality matters more than quantity.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli insho aniq shaklga ega. Kirishda savolni boshqacha ifodalang va pozitsiyani ayting. Asosiy abzatsda mavzu gapi, izoh, misol va bog‘lash bo‘lsin. Xulosada pozitsiyani takrorlang, yangi fikr qo‘shmang. Bog‘lovchilarni xilma-xil ishlating, miqdor emas, sifat muhim.

scenes.title: Xato: qolip va takror
board: ✓ Digital tools have transformed how we work.
✗ In conclusion, I introduce a new point…
✗ very good, very bad, very big

examples.t: Digital tools have transformed the way most of us work.
examples.uz: Raqamli vositalar ko‘pchiligimiz ishlash usulini o‘zgartirdi.

examples.t: The impact was significant rather than very big.
examples.uz: Ta’sir juda katta emas, balki sezilarli edi.

scenes.say_native: Yuqori ball uchun uchta narsadan qoching. Birinchisi — qolipli kirish: „Nowadays, technology is very important“. Bu juda umumiy va ma’lumot bermaydi. Aniqroq yozing: „Digital tools have transformed the way most of us work“. Ikkinchisi — „very“ ni ko‘p ishlatish: „very big“ o‘rniga „significant“, „very bad“ o‘rniga „harmful“, „very good“ o‘rniga „beneficial“. Uchinchisi — xulosada yangi fikr kiritish. Xulosa faqat avvalgi fikrlarni jamlaydi. O‘zbekcha „hozirgi kunda“ bilan boshlash odati ingliz inshosida ko‘pincha ortiqcha bo‘ladi, shuning uchun darhol mavzuga kiring.
scenes.say: Avoid three things. First, the empty opening: nowadays, technology is very important. Be specific: digital tools have transformed the way most of us work. Second, overusing very. Replace very big with significant, very bad with harmful, and very good with beneficial. Third, never add a new point in the conclusion, which should only sum up what you have said.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta narsadan qoching. Birinchisi — bo‘sh kirish, aniq yozing. Ikkinchisi — very ni ko‘p ishlatish: significant, harmful, beneficial kabi aniq so‘zlarni ishlating. Uchinchisi — xulosada yangi fikr qo‘shish; xulosa faqat avvalgisini jamlaydi.

scenes.title: Mashq: so‘zlarni kuchaytiring
board: 2) It is a very big problem.
3) Many people think it is very good for the economy.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni „very“ siz, aniqroq so‘zlar bilan qayta yozing. Birinchi: natijalar juda yomon edi. Ikkinchi: bu juda katta muammo. Uchinchi: ko‘pchilik buni iqtisodiyot uchun juda yaxshi deb hisoblaydi. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Rewrite three sentences without very, using more precise words. One: the results were very bad. Two: it is a very big problem. Three: many people think it is very good for the economy.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta gapni very siz, aniqroq so‘zlar bilan qayta yozing. Bir: natijalar juda yomon edi. Ikki: bu juda katta muammo. Uch: ko‘pchilik buni iqtisodiyot uchun juda yaxshi deb hisoblaydi.

scenes.title: Javoblar: aniq so‘zlar
board: 2) It is a serious / major problem.
3) …it is highly beneficial to the economy.

examples.t: The results were disappointing, particularly in the second quarter.
examples.uz: Natijalar, ayniqsa ikkinchi chorakda, ko‘ngilni qoldirdi.

examples.t: Many people believe it is highly beneficial to the economy.
examples.uz: Ko‘pchilik buni iqtisodiyot uchun juda foydali deb hisoblaydi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: „The results were disappointing“ yoki „alarming“, ya’ni tashvishli. Ikkinchi: „It is a serious problem“ yoki „a major problem“. Uchinchi: „Many people believe it is highly beneficial to the economy“. Bu yerda „highly“ qo‘shimchasi ham „very“ o‘rnini bosdi, lekin faqat ba’zi sifatlar bilan keladi: „highly beneficial“, „highly unlikely“, lekin „highly big“ emas. Bu kollokatsiya, ya’ni so‘zlarning odatiy birikmasi. Imtihonda bunday aniq birikmalar lug‘at mezonida yuqori ball beradi. Siz bitta mos so‘z topgan bo‘lsangiz ham, to‘g‘ri yo‘ldasiz, lekin sifat ma’noga aniq mos kelsin.
scenes.say: One: the results were disappointing, or alarming. Two: it is a serious problem, or a major problem. Three: many people believe it is highly beneficial to the economy. Highly works only with certain adjectives, such as highly beneficial or highly unlikely, but not highly big. These natural word partnerships, called collocations, raise your lexical resource mark.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: natijalar ko‘ngilni qoldirdi yoki tashvishli edi. Ikki: bu jiddiy yoki asosiy muammo. Uch: ko‘pchilik buni iqtisodiyot uchun juda foydali deb hisoblaydi. Highly faqat ba’zi sifatlar bilan keladi. Bunday tabiiy birikmalar, ya’ni kollokatsiyalar, lug‘at ballini oshiradi.

scenes.title: Akademik muhokama va Task 1
board: Academic discussion: respond to the professor + peers; add something new
Task 1: overview + key features, no opinions
rose sharply · peaked at · levelled off · accounted for

examples.t: I agree with Maya that cost matters, but I would add that access is equally important.
examples.uz: Mayaning xarajat muhim degan fikriga qo‘shilaman, lekin qulaylik ham teng darajada muhimligini qo‘shaman.

examples.t: Overall, sales rose steadily, peaking in 2022.
examples.uz: Umuman olganda, sotuv barqaror o‘sdi va 2022 yilda cho‘qqiga chiqdi.

examples.t: Renewable sources accounted for 40 per cent of the total.
examples.uz: Qayta tiklanuvchi manbalar umumiy hajmning qirq foizini tashkil etdi.

scenes.say_native: Ikkita turga qisqa to‘xtalamiz. TOEFL ning akademik muhokama topshirig‘ida professor savoli va ikki talabaning javobi beriladi. Siz fikringizni bildirasiz va muhokamaga yangi narsa qo‘shasiz: „I agree with Maya that cost matters, but I would add that access is equally important“. IELTS Task 1 da asosiy qoida: avval „overview“, ya’ni umumiy xulosa, keyin asosiy raqamlar; shaxsiy fikr yozmaysiz. Foydali fe’llar: „rose sharply“ — keskin o‘sdi, „peaked at“ — cho‘qqiga chiqdi, „levelled off“ — o‘zgarmasdan qoldi, „accounted for“ — ulushini tashkil etdi. Ulush uchun „for“ ni unutmang: „accounted for forty per cent“.
scenes.say: A short note on two task types. In TOEFL's academic discussion, you read a professor's question and two student posts. State your view and add something new: I agree with Maya that cost matters, but I would add that access is equally important. In IELTS Task One, write an overview first, then the key figures, and no personal opinion. Useful verbs are rose sharply, peaked at, levelled off and accounted for.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki topshiriq turi haqida qisqacha. TOEFL akademik muhokamada professor savoli va ikki talaba javobini o‘qiysiz, fikringizni bildirib yangi narsa qo‘shasiz. IELTS Task 1 da avval umumiy xulosa, keyin asosiy raqamlar, shaxsiy fikrsiz. Foydali fe’llar: rose sharply, peaked at, levelled off, accounted for.

scenes.title: Xato: jarimalar
board: ✗ Off-topic answer to a similar question
✗ Informal: kids, a lot of, gonna

examples.t: Always count your words: a short answer loses marks.
examples.uz: So‘zlarni doim sanang: qisqa javob ball yo‘qotadi.

examples.t: Use formal language: children, many, going to.
examples.uz: Rasmiy tildan foydalaning: children, many, going to.

scenes.say_native: Endi odatiy jarimalar. Birinchi: so‘z chegarasiga yetmaslik. Ikki yuz ellik so‘zli topshiriqda yuz sakson so‘z yozsangiz, topshiriq javobi mezoni bo‘yicha ball kamayadi. Ikkinchi: mavzudan chetga chiqish, ya’ni o‘xshash, lekin boshqa savolga javob yozish. Savolni diqqat bilan o‘qing. Uchinchi: Task 1 da shaxsiy fikr yozish. Faqat ma’lumotni tasvirlang. To‘rtinchi: norasmiy so‘zlar: „kids“ o‘rniga „children“, „a lot of“ o‘rniga „many“ yoki „numerous“, „gonna“ ni umuman ishlatmang. Beshinchi: juda uzun inshoga ball ko‘p berilmaydi, balki xatolar ko‘payadi, shuning uchun mo‘tadil hajmda yozing.
scenes.say: Now the common penalties. One: falling short of the word limit. One hundred and eighty words in a two-hundred-and-fifty-word task lowers the task mark. Two: going off-topic by answering a similar but different question. Three: giving opinions in Task One. Four: informal language such as kids, a lot of and gonna. And a much longer essay only gives you more chances to make errors.
scenes.say_uz: Odatiy jarimalar. Bir: so‘z chegarasiga yetmaslik. Ikki: o‘xshash, lekin boshqa savolga javob yozib mavzudan chiqish. Uch: Task 1 da fikr bildirish. To‘rt: kids, a lot of, gonna kabi norasmiy so‘zlar. Juda uzun insho esa faqat ko‘proq xato qilish imkonini beradi.

scenes.title: Mashq: xatolarni toping
board: 1) Kids nowadays are gonna spend too much time online.
2) Overall, the graph shows I think the government should act.
3) Internet have changed the life of peoples.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapdagi muammoni toping va to‘g‘rilang. Birinchi: bolalar hozir internetda juda ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazadi, norasmiy tilda. Ikkinchi: Task 1 da shaxsiy fikr kirib qolgan. Uchinchi: grammatik xatolar bor. Har birini rasmiy va to‘g‘ri variantda ayting. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Find and fix the problem in each sentence. One: kids nowadays are gonna spend too much time online. Two: overall, the graph shows I think the government should act. Three: Internet have changed the life of peoples.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapdagi muammoni toping va tuzating. Bir: norasmiy til. Ikki: Task 1 da shaxsiy fikr. Uch: grammatik xatolar.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tuzatishlar
board: 1) Children are likely to spend too much time online.
2) Overall, the graph shows a steady rise.
3) The internet has changed people’s lives.

examples.t: Children are likely to spend too much time online.
examples.uz: Bolalar internetda juda ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazishi ehtimoli bor.

examples.t: The internet has changed people’s lives.
examples.uz: Internet odamlar hayotini o‘zgartirdi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: „Children are likely to spend too much time online“. „Kids“ va „gonna“ rasmiy matnga mos emas. Ikkinchi: „Overall, the graph shows a steady rise“. „I think“ olib tashlandi, chunki Task 1 da fikr bo‘lmaydi. Uchinchi: „The internet has changed people’s lives“. Bu yerda uchta xato: „internet“ oldida „the“ kerak, „have“ o‘rniga „has“ bo‘ladi, chunki „internet“ birlikda, va „peoples“ emas, „people’s“ yoki „the lives of people“. Mana shu uch xato o‘zbek so‘zlovchilarida ko‘p uchraydi: artikl, kelishuv va ko‘plik.
scenes.say: One: children are likely to spend too much time online. Kids and gonna are too informal. Two: overall, the graph shows a steady rise. I think is removed, because Task One has no opinions. Three: the internet has changed people's lives. This has three fixes: the article the, has instead of have, and people's instead of peoples. These are classic errors with articles, agreement and plurals.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: bolalar internetda juda ko‘p vaqt o‘tkazishi ehtimoli bor. Kids va gonna rasmiy emas. Ikki: umuman, grafik barqaror o‘sishni ko‘rsatadi, Task 1 da fikr yo‘q. Uch: the internet has changed people’s lives, bu yerda artikl, kelishuv va ko‘plik tuzatildi.

scenes.title: Dialog: insho ustida ishlash
board: Listen: what are the two problems?
scenes.say_native: Endi repetitor bilan suhbatni tinglang. Mis Klark Jasurning inshosini ko‘rib chiqadi. Tinglang: ikkita muammo nima va repetitor nimani tavsiya qiladi?
scenes.say: Ms Clark: Jasur, your ideas are good, but you ran out of time. The conclusion is missing. Jasur: I spent twenty minutes on the introduction. Ms Clark: That is the problem. Also, you wrote the same sentence twice, with different words. Plan for five minutes, keep the introduction to two sentences and always leave three minutes to check. Jasur: So a short plan saves time later? Ms Clark: Exactly.
scenes.say_uz: Mis Klark: Jasur, fikrlaringiz yaxshi, lekin vaqtingiz yetmadi. Xulosa yo‘q. Jasur: Kirishga yigirma daqiqa sarfladim. Mis Klark: Muammo shu. Yana bir gapni boshqa so‘zlar bilan ikki marta yozibsiz. Besh daqiqa reja tuzing, kirishni ikki gapda cheklang va tekshirishga doim uch daqiqa qoldiring. Jasur: Demak, qisqa reja keyin vaqt tejaydi? Mis Klark: Aynan.

scenes.title: Mashq: dialogni tushunish
board: 1) What is missing from the essay?
2) Why did Jasur run out of time?
3) What three pieces of advice does Ms Clark give?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: inshoda nima yetishmaydi? Ikkinchi: Jasurning vaqti nega yetmadi? Uchinchi: Mis Klark qanday uchta maslahat beradi? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. What is missing from the essay? Why did Jasur run out of time? What three pieces of advice does Ms Clark give?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Inshoda nima yetishmaydi? Jasurning vaqti nega yetmadi? Mis Klark qanday uchta maslahat beradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: repetitor maslahati
board: 3) Plan five minutes · short introduction · check for three minutes

examples.t: Keep the introduction to two sentences.
examples.uz: Kirishni ikki gap bilan cheklang.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: xulosa yetishmaydi. Ikkinchi: Jasur kirishga yigirma daqiqa sarflagan. Uchinchi: besh daqiqa reja, ikki gaplik kirish va uch daqiqa tekshirish. Eslab qoling, imtihonda mukammal kirish yozishga urinish ko‘p odamni vaqtsiz qoldiradi. „Run out of time“ — vaqt tugab qolmoq. Jasurning ikkinchi muammosi — bir fikrni takrorlash, ya’ni „repetition“. Bu mukammallikka intilishdan, lekin yangi fikr topa olmaslikdan kelib chiqadi; shuning uchun rejada ikkita aniq fikr kerak. Sizning javobingizda ikkala muammo va uchta maslahat bo‘lsa, to‘g‘ri tinglagansiz.
scenes.say: One: the conclusion is missing. Two: Jasur spent twenty minutes on the introduction. Three: plan for five minutes, keep the introduction to two sentences and check for three minutes. Running out of time often comes from trying to write a perfect introduction. His second problem was repeating one idea in different words, which a clear plan would prevent.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: xulosa yo‘q. Ikki: Jasur kirishga yigirma daqiqa sarflagan. Uch: besh daqiqa reja, ikki gaplik kirish va uch daqiqa tekshiruv. Mukammal kirish yozishga urinish ko‘pincha vaqtni yeydi. Ikkinchi muammo — bir fikrni takrorlash, buni aniq reja oldini oladi.

scenes.title: Dialog: Task 1 tahlili
board: Two candidates review a Task 1 answer
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — ikki nomzod Task 1 javobini tekshiradi. Tinglang: unda nima yetishmaydi va qaysi iboralar javobni yaxshilaydi?
scenes.say: Nodira: My Task One lists every number, but my score was only six. Ben: Do you have an overview? Nodira: No. Ben: That is the issue. Start with one sentence saying the main trend, then pick two or three key figures. For instance, overall, car use fell while cycling rose, and public transport accounted for forty per cent in the final year. Nodira: So I should group the data, not copy it.
scenes.say_uz: Nodira: Task 1 javobimda hamma raqam sanalgan, lekin balim faqat olti bo‘ldi. Ben: Umumiy xulosa bormi? Nodira: Yo‘q. Ben: Muammo shu. Asosiy tendensiyani bitta gapda ayting, keyin ikki-uch asosiy raqamni tanlang. Masalan, umuman, mashina foydalanish kamaydi, velosiped oshdi, jamoat transporti oxirgi yilda qirq foizni tashkil etdi. Nodira: Demak, ma’lumotni ko‘chirmay, guruhlashim kerak.

scenes.title: Mashq: Task 1 savollari
board: 1) What is missing from Nodira’s answer?
3) Which verb phrase is used for percentages?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Nodiraning javobida nima yetishmaydi? Ikkinchi: u nimani tanlashi kerak? Uchinchi: foizlar uchun qaysi fe’l iborasi ishlatiladi? Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Answer three questions. What is missing from Nodira's answer? What should she select? Which verb phrase is used for percentages in the model?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savolga javob bering. Nodiraning javobida nima yetishmaydi? U nimani tanlashi kerak? Namunada foizlar uchun qaysi fe’l iborasi ishlatilgan?

scenes.title: Javoblar: Task 1
board: 1) An overview of the main trend

examples.t: Public transport accounted for forty per cent in the final year.
examples.uz: Jamoat transporti oxirgi yilda qirq foizni tashkil etdi.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: umumiy xulosa, ya’ni asosiy tendensiya haqidagi jumla yetishmaydi. Ikkinchi: ikki-uchta eng muhim raqam tanlanadi, hammasini sanash shart emas. Uchinchi: „accounted for“ iborasi foiz ulushini bildiradi. Bu mashqning saboqi shuki, Task 1 — hisobot emas, tanlab umumlashtirish. Ma’lumotni guruhlash: o‘sganlar bir abzatsda, kamayganlar boshqasida. Yana bir foydali iboralar: „by contrast“ — aksincha, „in comparison“ — solishtirganda. Agar sizning javobingizda umumiy xulosa va tanlangan raqamlar bo‘lsa, topshiriq muvaffaqiyatli.
scenes.say: One: an overview of the main trend. Two: two or three key figures, not every number. Three: accounted for, which expresses a percentage share. Task One is selective summary, not a list. Group the data, so rising items go in one paragraph and falling items in another, and link them with phrases like by contrast and in comparison.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: asosiy tendensiya bo‘yicha umumiy xulosa. Ikki: ikki-uch asosiy raqam, hammasi emas. Uch: accounted for foiz ulushini bildiradi. Task 1 — tanlab umumlashtirish, ro‘yxat emas. Ma’lumotni guruhlang va by contrast, in comparison bilan bog‘lang.

scenes.title: Talaffuz o‘rniga: yozma ohang va tekshiruv
board: Proofreading checklist: articles · agreement · tenses · spelling

examples.t: The number of students has risen, whereas the number of teachers has fallen.
examples.uz: Talabalar soni oshdi, o‘qituvchilar soni esa kamaydi.

examples.t: Many experts believe that this policy will fail.
examples.uz: Ko‘p mutaxassislar bu siyosat muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘ladi deb hisoblaydi.

scenes.say_native: Yozma imtihonda talaffuz emas, tekshiruv tizimi muhim. Uch daqiqalik tekshiruv ro‘yxati: birinchi artikllar, ikkinchi kelishuv, ya’ni „number of students has risen“, uchinchi zamonlar va to‘rtinchi imlo. „The number of students has risen“ — bu yerda ega „number“, shuning uchun „has“. Matnni ichingizda bir marta o‘qib chiqing: ohangi g‘alati eshitilgan joylar odatda xato bo‘ladi. Ikkinchi qoida: bitta uzun gap o‘rniga ikkita aniq gap yozing, chunki tinish belgilarsiz uzun gaplar xatoga olib keladi. Bu o‘zbek tilidagi uzun qo‘shma gaplardan farq qiladi, inglizcha akademik uslub ko‘proq o‘rtacha uzunlikdagi gaplarni yoqtiradi.
scenes.say: In a written exam, a checking system matters more than pronunciation. Use a three-minute checklist: articles, agreement, tenses and spelling. In the number of students has risen, the subject is number, so we use has. Read your text silently in your head. Where it sounds odd, there is often an error. And split a very long sentence in two.
scenes.say_uz: Yozma imtihonda tekshiruv tizimi muhim. Uch daqiqalik ro‘yxat: artikllar, kelishuv, zamonlar va imlo. The number of students has risen da ega number, shuning uchun has. Matnni ichingizda o‘qing, g‘alati eshitilgan joylarda xato bo‘lishi mumkin. Juda uzun gapni ikkiga bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: kirish va pozitsiya
board: Some people think zoos should be closed. To what extent do you agree?
scenes.say_native: Savol: „Ba’zilar hayvonot bog‘lari yopilishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Qanchalik rozisiz?“ Qirq soniya ichida kirish ayting: savolni boshqacha ifodalang, pozitsiyangizni bildiring va abzatslar rejasini qisqa ayting. Javobni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Some people think zoos should be closed. To what extent do you agree? In forty seconds, give an introduction. Paraphrase the question, state your position and add an outline sentence that says what your paragraphs will cover.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zilar hayvonot bog‘lari yopilishi kerak deb hisoblaydi. Qanchalik rozisiz? Qirq soniyada kirish ayting: savolni boshqacha ifodalang, pozitsiyangizni bildiring va abzatslaringiz nimani qamrashini aytuvchi gap qo‘shing.

scenes.title: Javob: kirish namunasi
board: Paraphrase: Some argue that zoos have no place in modern society.

examples.t: I partly agree, as the issue involves both animal welfare and public education.
examples.uz: Qisman roziman, chunki masala ham hayvonlar farovonligi, ham jamoatchilik ta’limiga tegishli.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy kirish: „Some argue that zoos have no place in modern society. I partly agree, as the issue involves both animal welfare and public education. This essay will consider these two aspects in turn.“ Birinchi gapda savol boshqacha aytildi: „should be closed“ o‘rniga „have no place in modern society“. Ikkinchida pozitsiya, uchinchida reja berildi. Bu uch gap — kirishning mukammal shakli. „Welfare“ — farovonlik, „in turn“ — navbat bilan. Sizning kirishingizda savol so‘zma-so‘z ko‘chirilmagan bo‘lsa va pozitsiya aniq bo‘lsa, topshiriq yaxshi bajarilgan.
scenes.say: A model introduction. Some argue that zoos have no place in modern society. I partly agree, as the issue involves both animal welfare and public education. This essay will consider these two aspects in turn. Notice that the question is paraphrased, not copied, that the position is clear and that the final sentence gives the plan.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy kirish. Ba’zilar hayvonot bog‘lari zamonaviy jamiyatda o‘rin tutmaydi deb hisoblaydi. Qisman roziman, chunki masala ham hayvonlar farovonligi, ham jamoatchilik ta’limiga tegishli. Inshoda bu ikki jihat navbat bilan ko‘riladi. Savol ko‘chirilmagan, pozitsiya aniq, oxirgi gap reja beradi.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
board: Penalties: word count · off-topic · informal · no proofreading
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsni jamlaymiz. Imtihonda to‘rt mezon teng og‘irlikka ega: savolga javob, izchillik, lug‘at va grammatika. Savolning hamma qismiga javob bering va shablonga ishonmang. Besh daqiqalik reja tuzing: ikkita kuchli fikr va misollar. Kirishda savolni boshqacha ifodalang va pozitsiyani ayting, xulosada yangi fikr qo‘shmang. Jarimalar: kam so‘z, mavzudan chetga chiqish, norasmiy til va tekshirmaslik. Task 1 da avval umumiy xulosa, keyin tanlangan raqamlar. Oxirgi uch daqiqani artikl, kelishuv va imlo tekshiruviga ajrating.
scenes.say: Let's review. Four equal criteria. Answer every part of the question and avoid memorised templates. Spend five minutes planning two strong ideas with examples. In the introduction, paraphrase the question and state your position. Do not add new ideas in the conclusion. Avoid penalties: too few words, off-topic answers, informal language and no proofreading. In Task One, begin with an overview.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlaymiz. To‘rtta teng mezon. Savolning hamma qismiga javob bering, shablondan qoching. Besh daqiqa ikkita kuchli fikr va misollarni rejalang. Kirishda savolni boshqacha ifodalab pozitsiyani ayting. Xulosada yangi fikr yo‘q. Jarimalardan saqlaning. Task 1 da umumiy xulosadan boshlang.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Homework: one full exam writing task under time
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa: bitta to‘liq yozish topshirig‘ini imtihon vaqtida bajaring. IELTS Task 2 insho tanlang: qirq daqiqa, kamida ikki yuz ellik so‘z. Vaqtni shunday taqsimlang: besh daqiqa reja, o‘ttiz ikki daqiqa yozish va uch daqiqa tekshirish. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: savolning hamma qismiga javob berilgan, kirishda pozitsiya bor, xulosada yangi fikr yo‘q, so‘zlar soni yetarli. Keyin to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha o‘zingizni baholang. Keyingi darsda imtihonning gapirish qismiga tayyorlanamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to write one full exam task under timed conditions. Choose an IELTS Task Two essay: forty minutes, at least two hundred and fifty words. Spend five minutes planning, thirty-two writing and three checking. Then mark yourself on the four criteria. Next time we prepare for the speaking part of the exam.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: bitta to‘liq yozish topshirig‘ini vaqt bilan bajaring. IELTS Task 2 insho tanlang: qirq daqiqa, kamida ikki yuz ellik so‘z. Besh daqiqa reja, o‘ttiz ikki daqiqa yozish va uch daqiqa tekshiruv. Keyin to‘rt mezon bo‘yicha o‘zingizni baholang. Keyingi safar gapirish qismiga tayyorlanamiz.

homework_uz: IELTS Task 2 turidagi bitta insho yozing: 40 daqiqa, kamida 250 so‘z (5 daqiqa reja, 32 yozish, 3 tekshirish). Savolning hamma qismiga javob bering, kirishda pozitsiyani ayting va xulosada yangi fikr qo‘shmang. Keyingi darsda gapirish qismini o‘rganamiz.

quiz.q: How many equal criteria are used in IELTS Writing?
quiz.why_uz: IELTS yozishda to‘rtta teng mezon bor.

quiz.q: What is the minimum word count for IELTS Task 2?
quiz.why_uz: Task 2 uchun kamida 250 so‘z talab qilinadi.

quiz.q: What should you do first in a five-minute plan?
options: Analyse the question and underline key words
quiz.why_uz: Avval savolni tahlil qilib, kalit so‘zlarni belgilash kerak.

options: Digital tools have transformed the way most of us work.
In this essay I will write about technology.
quiz.why_uz: Aniq va mazmunli kirish yuqori ball beradi.
Xulosa pozitsiyani takrorlaydi, yangi fikr qo‘shilmaydi.

quiz.q: Which sentence is correct for IELTS Task 1?
options: I think the graph is boring.
Overall, sales rose steadily, peaking in 2022.
quiz.why_uz: Task 1 da fikr emas, ma’lumot tasviri bo‘ladi.

options: The number of students have risen.
The number of students has risen.
The numbers of student has risen.

In Cambridge Advanced, which part is compulsory?
